cards.editorialAnalysis: Easy fails plausible alternatives (guide lines 5,17): a vehicle on the rink cannot sharpen worn skate blades; drawing permanent face-off markings and repairing boards are not credible intermission resurfacer jobs. Nominal labels read grammatically and notes are substantive. The key and six facts are supported, but broad maintenance category alone does not make every option plausible.

fields.claimAnalysis: IIHF Ice Resurfacer directly supports cleaning/smoothing. Distractors sharpening skates and repairing boards are mechanically implausible jobs for a vehicle driving on ice; easy requires all four credible.

cards.editorialAnalysis: Easy fails the premise exclusion rule: asking the program before the free program while offering that same free program yields an impossible self-predecessor. The qualification order in the complete COC original supports short then free, and participants determined by short-program results. Two clear sentences.

Physical pages 13,14,10,5 collectively support the helmet/chinstrap and other body parts. Two grammatical sentences; useful repetition is permitted.
